t: Why any of it is attractive
a: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا مَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ زِينَةً لَّهَا لِنَبْلُوَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا
p: Innā jaʿalnā mā ʿala-l-arḍi zīnatan lahā li-nabluwahum ayyuhum aḥsanu ʿamalā.
m: Indeed, We have made that which is on the earth adornment for it that We may test them [as to] which of them is best in deed.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
